integrity: The finite verifier provides finite tests; the uniform statements are established by explicit equivariant factorization, orbit counts, and an equivariant section argument.
scientific_limitations: Finite sets only; counts principal ideals, not all ideals; the full 2022 precursor was not directly inspected; bounded priority search does not prove global novelty.
title: The three-rank two-sided ideal order of finite magma monoids
